hints.title: Verifying Empty Move Coordinate
hints.text: The target cell (r, c) on the 8x8 grid must be empty initially, represented by a period character.

hints.title: Scanning Eight Directional Vectors
hints.text: Check all 8 cardinal and diagonal directions (-1, 0, 1 deltas) for a valid bracketed line.

hints.title: Line Bracket Length Criterion
hints.text: A direction is legal if it immediately encounters at least one opposite colored piece and terminates with a piece of the player color.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Directional line raycasting on constant size game board.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating full game tree is unnecessary when verifying legality of a single turn.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant space ray traversal finishes in at most 8 * 8 = 64 steps.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should verify line length >= 3 (including original move and endpoints) and opposite piece sequence.
